name: Manji
source:
The wife is cheating on the man with another woman. The man tries to show his love to his wife by lying down with that woman partner. The original is a novel by Junichiro Tanizaki, and in 1983 the  movie of the same name was produced by Toei.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
妻子背着丈夫与另一名女子偷情。丈夫为了向妻子证明自己的爱，也与那名女子发生了关系。原作是谷崎润一郎的小说，1983年东映又将其改编为同名电影。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/04/vn-of-year-1984.html]vndbreview[/url]]
